  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, April 26, 2022  6:00 PM  Teleconference/Council Chambers

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order via teleconference and in-person in the City Hall Council Chambers at 6:00 p.m. on Tuesday, April 26,
2022. The agenda for the Special Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth
below.
Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, April 21, 2022.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361), City Council Resolution Nos. 2487, 2490, 2491, 2493,
  2498, 2499 and 2503, due to the continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing
  directives as a result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being broadcast via
  teleconference. Members of the public may participate in-person in the Council Chambers, or virtually in
  the meeting in the following ways:
  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1 669 900 6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID:
  870 0098 8666 Meeting Password: 066081. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the
  call in option from a phone line.)
  - Public correspondence may be emailed to the City Clerk at laurenp@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails
  received before 3:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record.
  - Members of the public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.
  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 870 0098 8666, Meeting Password: 066081. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following
  process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the
  lower portion of your screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the
  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  APRIL 26, 2022

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR ZERUNYAN at 6:07 pm in the Council Chambers of City Hall and remotely via
teleconference, in accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and City Council Resolution
Nos. 2487, 2490, 2491, 2493, 2498, 2499, 2503 and proposed Resolution No. 2505, due to
the continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing directives as a
result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit
  Accountant Fernando Estrada

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY WORKSHOP

City Manager Grammer introduced Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead.

Administrative Services Director Whitehead provided a staff report (per the agenda
materials), as well as a presentation summarizing the following topics:

  •  IT Operations Overview
  •  Staffing
  •  Vendors
  •  Internet Connections
  •  Residential & Business City-Wide Internet
  •  Digital City & “Internet of Things” Overview
  •  Purchasing & Project Management
  •  Disaster Preparedness & Recovery
  •  Security Controls
  •  Strategic Planning
  •  Technology Awards

5.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:50 p.m. MAYOR ZERUNYAN adjourned the City Council meeting to the regular City
Council meeting at 7:00 p.m.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Frank V. Zerunyan
City Clerk  Mayor
